definition.title: TensorSpine Editor acceptance fixtures
definition.summary: The one primitive the editor's acceptance fixtures need and the reference base does not declare.
definition.description:
A base of the editor's test material, never of a model anybody ships. It exists for a single reason: no unit of the reference base declares a **constant** slot, so the whole `constants` half of the grammar — a slot in a primitive, a `constants` entry in a document, a `bindings.constants` rule and its scoped form — is reachable by no file of the repository. This base declares one primitive that has one, and `editor/tests/fixtures/models/declared-constant.json` instantiates it.

Its axes and its precision roles are the reference base's: a document that reads this base declares both, which is how a laboratory's own base sits beside the shared vocabulary.
definition.note: Editor test material. Not a released primitive library: it carries no witness and nothing outside editor/tests/fixtures/ reads it.
